source: CardInsider extraction pipeline (v3.1.1 baseline) + redemption_rules transform v1
_note: Eleven base_rate rules stated a point COUNT as a percentage. A base rule typed cashback_pct holding the card's points-per-rupee number renders that number as a percent: AU CA Metal earns 2 Reward Points per Rs.100, worth 0.5% at Rs.0.25/point, and displayed 2.00%. The overstatement is always exactly 1/rp_value_standard. Only the 11 cards carrying their own evidence are changed — each has a sibling rule stating explicit mechanics ('8 Reward Points on every Rs.100'), which pins the card's convention and confirms base_reward_rate is points-per-rupee rather than an already-collapsed rupee rate. Each is retyped to points_per_spend and renamed to state N, so the gate can read it. The other 45 cards in the same shape are deliberately untouched: nothing on those cards disambiguates the unit, and guessing would repeat the axis_bank_neo error in the opposite direction. All 11 corrections go DOWN.
